title: Neighbourhood bakery in Riyadh, Arabic and English
opening: I need a website for my bakery, in Arabic and English
persona: Noura Alqahtani, owner of a small family bakery. Answers warmly and briefly, sometimes mixes in an Arabic word. Not technical.
facts: The bakery is called Khubz Alhay (خبز الحي), in Al Malqa, Riyadh.
Open daily 6 am to 1 pm, closed Fridays.
Best sellers: date maamoul, zaatar manakeesh, and sourdough. Prices are on the menu file.
The one thing a visitor should do is find the shop on the map or order on WhatsApp at +966 50 000 0000.
Customers are families in the neighbourhood and office workers on their way to work.
Arabic is the main language; English is for expat customers.
Has a hand-drawn logo of a bread loaf and a few phone photos of the counter. No domain yet.
Does not want online payments, a blog, or a loyalty program on the site.
taste: If asked for a material or object with the right colour: the clay of the old oven and the green of the shop's front door. Likes warm, simple pages with big Arabic type. Prefers light pages.

files.about.md: Our family has baked in this neighbourhood since 2019. Everything is baked the same morning. We use dates from Al Qassim.
